name: Azul Tequila Mexican Cantina
summary: A Mexican cantina on Main Street. Come hungry for tacos and bring a few friends.

name: Cafe Tula Taqueria
summary: A taqueria on Commercial Street in downtown Hanceville. It sits close to the shops, so it pairs nicely with an afternoon of browsing.

name: Country Wok
summary: Chinese food cooked in an open kitchen, so you can watch your order come together. Don't leave without trying the eggrolls or Grandma's Cantonese fried rice.

name: Jack's
summary: Jack's, the Southern burger and biscuit chain, has a spot on Styles Street. It's handy for breakfast on the way to work.

name: McDonald's
summary: The McDonald's on Main Street, for a quick meal when the kids are hungry and time is short.

name: Pop's Cafe Hanceville
summary: A hometown diner on Main Street known for fluffy pancakes. Meatloaf is on the menu every single day.

name: Subway
summary: Subway's Main Street shop makes your sandwich to order. It's a fast lunch when you're short on time.

name: Reyes Pizza
summary: A local pizza place on Main Street. Pick up a pie for family night or before the next ballgame.

name: Taco Bell
summary: Tacos and burritos to go on Main Street.

name: HanceVegas Coffee Shop
summary: A downtown coffee shop with one of the best names in town. Stop in for your morning cup and a little conversation.

name: Hanceville Nutrition
summary: Smoothies and shakes on Main Street. Good for a quick pick me up any time of day.

name: Cut N Up Barber and Style
summary: A family barbershop open since 2008, right next door to Hanceville Drug Co. The shop cuts hair for men, women and kids. Walk ins are welcome for haircuts and styling, and color and perms are by appointment only.
hours: Tuesday and Thursday 8 AM to 5 PM; Wednesday and Friday 9 AM to 5 PM; Saturday 8 AM to 2 PM; closed Sunday and Monday

name: The Warehouse Barber
summary: A downtown barbershop for fresh haircuts and clean lines.

name: Hanceville Barber and Style Shop
summary: A longtime barber and style shop on Commercial Street that has kept plenty of Hanceville heads neatly trimmed.

name: Freedom Motors of Alabama
summary: A used car dealer on Main Street with cars and trucks for sale.

name: Jerry's Used Cars
summary: A used car lot on Highway 31. They take trade ins, too.

name: Kretzschmar Motors
summary: A used car dealer on Highway 91, a short drive from Hanceville.

name: S and N Auto Sales
summary: A used car lot on Main Street in Hanceville.

name: Barbee Truck Sales
summary: A used truck dealer on Highway 31. Worth a stop if you need a pickup that can handle real work.

name: Whitaker Motors
summary: A used car dealer on Highway 31 in the Hanceville area.

name: J and D Auto and Tire Service
summary: Oil changes, tires, alignments and AC repair at one shop. If your car can't make the trip, they can tow it in.

name: Elliston Repair and Tire
summary: Engine diagnostics, brakes, alignments, oil changes, suspension and transmission work, plus tires. They handle it all at their shop on Highway 31.

name: Verhine Service Center
summary: A Main Street shop for everyday car repairs. It's open on weekdays.

name: Dave's Body Shop
summary: A local body shop for collision repair. Get the dings and dents fixed without leaving town.

name: College Tire
summary: Tires and auto service at the corner of Highway 31 and Highway 91.

name: Tire Barn Plus
summary: They sell new and used tires and wheels, and they also do brakes, lift kits and detailing.

name: Dusty's Small Engines
summary: Repairs mowers, chainsaws, trimmers, blowers and generators from most brands. You'll get a quote before any work starts, and they can pick up heavy equipment.

name: Hanceville Tire and Towing
summary: A local wrecker service. Call them when your car can't get where it's going on its own.

name: A, R and C Specialists
summary: A Hanceville company that services heating, air conditioning and commercial refrigeration.

name: Hanceville Drug Co
summary: A locally owned pharmacy that has been open since 1916. The old fashioned soda fountain inside serves ice cream, sundaes and shakes.

name: Animal Medical Hospital
summary: A vet clinic for small and large animals, from checkups and shots to surgery.

name: MaeMae's Paws
summary: Dog grooming, boarding and daycare. Your pup can get a bath, an overnight stay or a day of play.

name: Kids World
summary: A licensed child care center for infants through school age children.

name: Peoples Bank of Alabama, Hanceville
summary: The Peoples Bank of Alabama branch on Main Street.

name: Cullman Savings Bank, Hanceville
summary: The Hanceville branch of Cullman Savings Bank, with an ATM on site.

name: Traditions Bank, Dodge City
summary: A Traditions Bank branch with a lobby, drive thru and ATM. It's open Saturday mornings, too.

name: Merchants Bank of Alabama, Hanceville
summary: The Merchants Bank of Alabama branch on Main Street.

name: Alfa Insurance, Hanceville Office
summary: Stefani Nelson's Alfa office on Main Street handles auto, home and life coverage.
hours: Monday to Friday 8 AM to 5 PM; closed Saturday and Sunday

name: Hagar Guitars LLC
summary: Custom electric and bass guitars built by hand in Hanceville. They also do repairs and upgrades.

name: Burns Florist
summary: A locally owned flower shop that makes custom bouquets and offers same day delivery.

name: Louisiana Pacific Corporation
summary: LP's Hanceville plant makes oriented strand board, the wood panels used to build houses.

name: Birmingham Fastener, Hanceville Distribution Center
summary: Birmingham Fastener's distribution center in Hanceville ships fasteners to industrial customers.

name: Design Technologies, LLC
summary: Builds electrical wire harnesses and electronic control boxes for manufacturers, from the design stage through production.

name: Quality Inn
summary: A hotel on Main Street, close to everything in town.

name: Thompson Cat Rentals
summary: Equipment rentals for big jobs and small ones, from the Thompson location in Hanceville.

name: Shrine of the Most Blessed Sacrament
summary: One of the best known landmarks in the area. Visitors and pilgrims are welcome to walk the quiet grounds and stop by the gift shop.
